name: Pulau Aur
source: e-Solat JHR01 "Pulau Aur"; GeoNames 1732794 (T.ISL). Radius covers Pulau Aur and Pulau Dayang.

name: Pulau Tioman
source: e-Solat PHG01 "Pulau Tioman"; GeoNames 1734910 (T.ISL). Radius covers the island (lat 2.70 to 2.90) and Pulau Tulai (GeoNames 1734940, 14.3 km from the centre). The Rompin coast is more than 50 km away.

name: Genting Sempah
source: e-Solat PHG05 "Genting Sempah"; GeoNames 1745114 (T.PASS). The Selangor side of the pass keeps its Gombak zone. 8.3 km from Genting Highlands.

name: Bukit Tinggi
source: e-Solat PHG05 "Bukit Tinggi"; GeoNames 1735133 Kampung Bukit Tinggi, Bentong.

name: Genting Highlands
source: e-Solat PHG06 "Genting Higlands"; GeoNames 1735132. Radius covers Gohtong Jaya (3.7 km) and stops short of Genting Sempah (8.3 km) and Bukit Tinggi (9.2 km). The area applies only inside Bentong, so the Selangor land in the circle, which is in Hulu Selangor district, keeps its Hulu Selangor zone (SGR01 in 2026, SGRHSL from 2027).

name: Bukit Fraser
source: e-Solat PHG06 "Bukit Fraser"; GeoNames 1732671. The Hulu Selangor side keeps its Hulu Selangor zone.

name: Puncak Gunung Jerai
source: e-Solat KDH07 "Puncak Gunung Jerai"; GeoNames 1735480 (T.MT). Radius stops short of Gurun (5.5 km) and Yan (7 km). The Yan side of the mountain keeps KDH02.

name: Bukit Larut
source: e-Solat PRK07 "Bukit Larut"; GeoNames 9172440 (P.PPLL, the Maxwell Hill resort). Radius stops short of Taiping (6.6 km). The Kuala Kangsar side keeps PRK02.

name: Gunung Kinabalu
source: e-Solat SBH06 "Gunung Kinabalu"; GeoNames 1736632 (T.MT, the summit). Radius covers Laban Rata (3 km) and stops short of Timpohon Gate (7.5 km), Kinabalu Park HQ (7.9 km) and Kundasang (10.8 km). The Kota Belud side keeps SBH07.
